_comment: The upstream Atomizer machine (the triple-Z printer from Chermain et al. 2025). Every value is copied verbatim from the constants block at the top of src/atom/kinematics3z.py as it stood at commit e7b71ea. Integer values are written without a decimal point on purpose: Taichi captures these as globals when compiling a kernel, so their Python type is part of the behaviour the golden test pins down. Do not edit this file to describe our machine - edit ours.json.
